L1_address_does_not_vary_the_task.consequence: held-out episode addresses hold out nothing about the task, so a generalization claim on this generator has to vary `configuration`, which `TrainConfig` fixes for a whole run

L2_objective_not_consumable.consequence: goal-conditioned generalization over held-out objectives is not expressible: the actor cannot see which objective it is being scored against

L3_trainconfig_generator_configuration_i.consequence: the only thing `JointTrainer` can vary per episode is the objective, and the objective is invisible to the actor (L2), so the integrated trainer cannot present this generator with a distribution of tasks
